purpose: Prevent diagnostic loops and force material forward progress through the already-frozen I6 postproduction sequence without changing Evergreen semantics, duplicating runtime state or turning each defect into a separate release cycle.

rules.text: Exactly one I6 mini-gate may be operationally active. The next mini-gate cannot open until the current mini-gate reaches its required mini-freeze or an exact HOLD dependency is recorded.
A review, green governance workflow, state reconfirmation, elapsed time or repeated diagnostic is not progress. Each mini-gate must produce its required material evidence and state transition.
A discriminant already executed may not be repeated unless source, artifact, configuration, permissions, dataset, snapshot, harness or another causal input relevant to that discriminant has changed.

A failed functional proof does not authorize another full candidate by itself. Before rebuilding, isolate the violated invariant and owning layer, prove the minimum causal change, and bound the fix. Rebuild only when a source or release input relevant to that proven cause actually changes.

Do not create a new build/Preview for each small defect discovered inside the same active mini-gate. Accumulate bounded source corrections for the active gate and certify them together, except when the existing candidate itself is required to reproduce or isolate a runtime-only cause.

Once all known contracts of the active mini-gate are source-ready and targeted causal checks pass, create one immutable closure candidate, run one complete Preview acceptance matrix, then promote that same artifact to LIVE if the governing gate permits it. A failed closure candidate returns to root-cause isolation, not to general diagnosis.

Every execution cut resolves to PASS, FIX or HOLD. PASS requires proof. FIX requires a reproducible defect, isolated cause, bounded correction and causal regression. HOLD requires one exact blocking dependency.

Previously accepted PASS evidence remains reusable while its release identity and relevant causal inputs remain unchanged. A PASS capability is reopened only by reproducible causal regression or a governed lineage exception.
Each mini-gate uses one authoritative executor path. No one-shot branch, parallel methodology or replacement workflow is created to work around a failure inside the active gate.

Do not spend an execution cut only reconfirming authority, state or prior PASS evidence when those inputs are unchanged. Read the minimum authority needed for the active gate and immediately execute its next material action.

Every resumed session starts from CONTROL_PLANE.json plus this discipline lock and the exact evidence of the active mini-gate. Do not re-run broad repository or historical diagnostics unless the active evidence proves causal drift.

When the active mini-gate reaches its required proven terminal state, seal it and move immediately to the next frozen mini-gate in the same execution flow. Do not insert an extra review round unless explicit human authorization or business adjudication is required by the governing addendum.

Paula participates only where human action is materially required: visual/legal acceptance, an exact APPLY authorization, or a business conflict that cannot be adjudicated mechanically. No local/manual command is requested unless technically unavoidable.

Every authorized operational write follows diff -> authorization -> controlled apply -> before/after receipt -> readback/integrity. A partial failure never authorizes blind re-import or duplicate application.

While one mini-gate is active, source files already supplied for later data gates may be hashed, inventoried, normalized and schema-validated as non-authoritative preparation only. This preparation may not change CONTROL_PLANE state, open the later gate, execute operational writes, perform an APPLY, claim formal progress or bypass the frozen I6 order.
Postproduction exit progress is measured only by frozen I6 mini-gates, not by hours, diagnostic rounds, commits or workflows executed.

fastPathExecution.candidatePolicy: NO_NEW_FULL_CANDIDATE_UNTIL_CAUSAL_FIX_IS_PROVEN; THEN BATCH ALL ACTIVE_GATE_FIXES INTO ONE CLOSURE CANDIDATE
fastPathExecution.retestPolicy: RETEST_ONLY_CAUSALLY_AFFECTED CHECKS DURING FIX; RUN_FULL_GATE_MATRIX ONCE AT CLOSURE

parallelPreparationBoundary.purpose: Reduce elapsed time before I6.2-I6.7 without executing them out of order.
allowed: normalize field names and source values in isolated artifacts
validate source schema and required columns
prepare deterministic parsers and non-authoritative source manifests
identify missing source inputs that require business delivery
forbiddenUntilPredecessorGatePass: CONTROL_PLANE transition to a later gate
authoritative later-gate dry-run against operational state
production deployment for a later gate
formal percentage credit for a later gate

forbiddenAsProgress: operational writes are zero without baseline evidence

notes: This lock is execution discipline only; the Evergreen V4 addendum remains the governing definition of I6.
CONTROL_PLANE.json remains the sole persistent runtime state authority.
I6_POSTSALIDA_PLAN_LOCK_20260914.json remains state-free and its frozen sequence is unchanged.
The 2026-09-16 fast-path additions do not authorize any data mutation or later-gate execution; they only constrain how the already-authorized I6 work is executed.
